name: newsh2-267
summary: Grey drilling machine seen from above, lying along the screen with its drill pointing down: a round drum body that tapers into a conical drill bit wrapped in spiral flights, a shiny grey dome cap at the top end, brown armour shoulder plates with cream corner knobs, a dark spine plate with two glowing red light slots and a tan stud, and an axle through the dome carrying a brown yoke whose arms curve down either side to grey piston runners on the ground. Hard armour plates and arms; round drum, cone and dome.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours. Cues: the lower body is a conical drill bit with diagonal spiral flights (the sprite's diagonal light bands); the top is a riveted steel dome cap on a drum; brown/brass armour plates wrap the drum's shoulders; the red lights are glowing slots set in a dark central plate; the side arms are armoured brass links down to vertical piston legs.

traits: round cross-section: about as tall as half its width (~6-7 px at the widest)
tapers smoothly from the 13 px wide drum to a point at row 27
diagonal spiral flights (raised ridges) running down-left across the cone
mid grey metal, darker right side is shadow
features.note: The main grey body below the armour: a drum turning into a conical drill bit. Must not be a low flat slab.

traits: round light-grey dome on a short drum neck, cols 8-14, rows 2-7
highest point of the machine
glossy metal; the near-white pixels are sheen, not a knob
features.note: Dome cap at the top end of the drum.

traits: two horizontal glowing red slots at rows 9 and 11
orange-white hot centre
set into the dark spine plate, framed by it (slightly recessed)
features.note: Emissive lights; the most eye-catching detail.

traits: dark charcoal plate down the centre, cols 9-13, rows 8-18
raised above the drum, crisp chamfered edges
frames the red lights with bars between them
features.note: Dark central plate carrying the lights.

traits: brown armour plates on both upper corners (cols 5-8 and 14-17, rows 8-12)
wrap the drum's shoulders, standing as tall as the drum
hard, faceted plates with crisp edges
features.note: Brown shoulder armour either side of the spine.

traits: small cream rounded knobs on the armour's inner top corners
left one larger (cols 6-8), right one smaller (cols 13-14)
features.note: Cream bolts/knobs on the shoulder armour.

traits: brown arms rising to tips above the axle at rows 2-3 (cols 3-5 and 17-19)
curve out and down to the runners at row 10
constant thickness, about 2 px
features.note: Brown yoke either side of the head.

traits: thin light-grey rod at row 5 through the dome to both arms
straight, constant diameter
features.note: Cross axle joining the dome and the yoke.

traits: straight grey round legs at cols 1 and 21, rows 10-18
constant diameter, round
lighter at the top (lit), resting on the ground
features.note: Grey piston legs/runners at the ends of the yoke.

traits: small tan stud at col 11, rows 15-17
on a light cross ridge at row 15
features.note: Tan stud at the bottom of the spine.
